reason: The power cuts are only half my problem; on many days there is no water in the tank either, and a battery does nothing for that, so for twenty-two thousand my wife's hands and the bucket still do the job. If I ever buy a big machine for the house I wait for Diwali or a wedding when the dealer throws in something, not an ordinary week.
objection: Water supply is not reliable here. A machine that finishes the wash without power is no use if the tank is empty, and a semi-automatic still needs someone to fill and drain it by hand.
would_change_my_mind: A festival or wedding-season offer from my own dealer, with the solar panel thrown in free and a few thousand off, plus a neighbour I trust who has used it through one monsoon and one summer without trouble.
